texts.zh:
我方大使团因我们派驻[event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]的使者，[event_envoy.GetName]的工作情况而忧心已经有段日子了。而今曝光的证据表明[event_envoy.GetSheHe]似乎已沦为瘾君子，那是一种源自[provider_country.GetName]的外星药品，已经证明它就[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言极具成瘾性。

尽管交易这种药品在[provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]严重违法，但冷酷无情的毒枭们掌管的黑市日进斗金，生意兴隆。这些毒枭们貌似是把这种药品作为强效春药介绍给了[event_envoy.GetHerHim]，[event_envoy.GetName]因而被毒枭玩弄于股掌之间，被迫俯首听命来换取用以满足[event_envoy.GetHerHis]瘾癖的药品。
texts.en:
Our ambassador corps has for some time been concerned at the performance of [event_envoy.GetName], one of our officials to the [event_envoy.GetEnvoyLocation]. Now, evidence has come to light that [event_envoy.GetSheHe] appear[event_envoy.GetSXX] to have fallen prey to an alien substance from the [provider_country.GetName] that has proven extremely addictive to [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

Although the trade in this substance is highly illegal among the [provider_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], a lucrative black market run by cutthroat drug lords has sprung up. These drug lords, who apparently managed to introduce it to [event_envoy.GetHerHim] as a potent aphrodisiac, now exert a considerable degree of influence over [event_envoy.GetName], who is forced to do their bidding in return for satisfying [event_envoy.GetHerHis] cravings.

tooltips.zh: [event_envoy.GetName]将被紧急替换。然而，事实会证明我们不可能掩盖外交使团的污点。
tooltips.en: [event_envoy.GetName] is replaced with immediate effect. However, it will prove impossible to cover up this stain on our diplomatic corps.

summary.text:
# 药物滥用 / Substance Abuse

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/envoy_events.txt:2963-3110`; `common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

Galactic Community 特使的随机事件：五年脉冲（action.2211）的负面列表 on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list，权重见分支栏（common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592）；on_action 会先检查事件触发条件、不满足的从列表中剔除，所以只要有一个能触发就必有一个触发。通常共用5400天的 recent_envoy_event 冷却。 本事件：特使驻在某国，无 recent_envoy_event；权重20/180。

A random Galactic Community envoy event: the negative list of the five-year pulse (action.2211), on_five_year_random_pulse_country_negative_list, weights in the branches (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:576-592); on_actions check each event's trigger first and drop the failing ones, so as long as any can fire one always does. Most share a 5400-day recent_envoy_event cooldown. This event: An envoy posted to a country, no recent_envoy_event; weight 20 of 180.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

特使滥用药物。选项一：解雇（特使死亡/被清除，获得3600天的 diplo_corps_lost_control 修正）；选项二：召回重训，特使获得“药物滥用者”特质。

The envoy abuses substances. Option one: fire (the envoy is removed, with the 3600-day modifier diplo_corps_lost_control); option two: recall for retraining, the envoy gains the Substance Abuser trait.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

二选一。

One of two.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了脚本触发和选项；与同一列表中的其他事件互相独立。

Trigger and options were checked against the script; independent of the other events in the same list.
